Publish a repository

Keep using Git. QPository signs your committed state locally and anchors its proof on RougeChain.

qpo init
qpo push --web /path/to/website/dist

The export adds the proven repository to this website. Rebuild and publish the site to make the new snapshot visible. Private keys remain on your machine.

You need a funded testnet identity and a configured storage provider. This release supports public repositories only.
